Build, Execution, Deployment settings: the Toolchains tile when exactly one tool comes from exactly one plugin
Build, Execution, Deployment settings: the Stepping tile when exactly one debugger supports filters
Build, Execution, Deployment settings: the Stepping tile when exactly one debugger supports filters and its filters are customized
Build, Execution, Deployment settings: the footer of a kind's page list when it lists exactly one page

en-US.desktop.buildSettings.directoryNote: This page lists the subpages and their status only; it does not show what plugins add.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.applyHelp:
Apply writes the changes, then reads them back; the page shows the values read back.
Cancel discards every change and writes no file.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.scopeHelp:
Global defaults: the choice every project shares, saved in the app's user settings.
Current project: applies to this project only, saved to .lithe/toolchains/local.json (a local file, not committed).
A tool the project does not set uses the global default. Running processes use a new version after they restart.
Changes in the two scopes are kept apart; switching loses neither.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.trustedHelp: This project is trusted on this Mac: Lithe may probe and run the tool environments inside it.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.filterPlaceholder: Filter by name, version, path or plugin
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.redetect: Detect again: probe every tool's installations and versions again, without writing any file.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.trustBanner: {count} tools come from environments inside the project ({sources}). Lithe does not probe or run them until you trust the project.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.trustBannerOne: 1 tool comes from an environment inside the project ({sources}). Lithe does not probe or run it until you trust the project.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.pluginGroupHelp: Runtimes plugins declare for their own language servers or background processes. You rarely change them, so the group starts collapsed; their problems still count under Needs Attention.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.selectTool: Select a tool on the left to see its details
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.restoreAutomaticTi: Drop the global choice so the tool is found automatically again. Takes effect after Apply.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.restoreInheritedTi: Drop the project's choice so the tool follows the global default again. Takes effect after Apply.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.problemConflict: Several plugins declare this tool: {plugins}. Their definitions may differ, so Lithe stops resolving it to avoid using the wrong one.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.problemNotFound: {tool} was not found. After installing it, click ⟳ in the toolbar to detect again, or add its installation directory below.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.problemVersion: Every installation found is older than the minimum version {plugin} requires.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.problemProbeFailed: Detecting the version failed. Check the tool's installation, then detect again.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.problemTrust: This project provides {tool} through {source} ({home}). Lithe does not probe or run it until you trust the project.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.effectiveHelp:
The program the tool uses now, as Core resolves it.
Changes are only a draft until you click Apply or OK at the bottom of the window; then they are written and read back.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.optionsProjectHelp:
Applies to the current project only.
Inherit follows the global default; when the project has an environment a plugin declares (a wrapper, a virtual environment), it comes first once you trust the project.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.optionsGlobalHelp:
The default every project shares.
Automatic looks in the order the plugin declares: {order}, and takes the first installation that meets the version requirement.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.optionsGlobalHelpP:
The default every project shares.
Automatic takes the first installation that meets the version requirement.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.addHelp:
Choose the installation root that contains the tool's programs (the JDK directory, for example, not its bin directory).
Checking only reads the version and changes the draft; nothing is written until Apply.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.steppingPending: Changes not applied yet; they take effect in the next debug session.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.skipCodeHelp:
One pattern per row, written the way the debugger expects.
Matching frames are dimmed in the call stack.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.skipSyntheticsHelp: Steps straight over methods the compiler generates, such as lambda bridge methods.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.skipStaticInitiali: Stepping into a class does not stop in its static initializer block.
en-US.desktop.buildSettings.hideFilteredFrames: Frames the rules above filter out fold into one row in the call stack; expand it to see them.
en-US.desktop.toolchains.discoveryIncomplete: Some enabled plugins could not be read. The tool list may be incomplete; check the logs and reload after fixing them.

zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.directoryNote: 这一页只列子页和状态摘要，不直接展示插件注入的内容。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.issuesAll: 在工具链中查看全部 {count} 项
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.directoryToolchain: {tools} 个工具 · 来自 {plugins} 个插件 · 当前显示{scope}
1 个工具 · 来自 {plugins} 个插件 · 当前显示{scope}
{tools} 个工具 · 来自 1 个插件 · 当前显示{scope}
1 个工具 · 来自 1 个插件 · 当前显示{scope}
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.directoryDebuggers: 单步：{count} 个调试器支持过滤
单步：1 个调试器支持过滤
单步：{count} 个调试器支持过滤 · {customized} 个已自定义
单步：1 个调试器支持过滤 · 已自定义
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.directoryKindMore: {names} 等 {count} 个 · 由插件提供
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.applyHelp:
点“应用”写入后会重新读取，界面显示的是重新读取到的实际生效值。
点“取消”放弃全部修改，不写任何文件。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.scopeHelp:
全局默认：所有项目共用的选择，保存在应用的用户设置。
当前项目：只对这个项目生效，保存到本项目的 .lithe/toolchains/local.json（本机文件，不提交）。
项目没有指定的工具沿用全局默认。已启动的进程需要重启后才使用新版本。
两个作用域的修改分别保留，切换不会丢失。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.trustedHelp: 本机此项目已信任：允许探测和运行项目内的工具环境。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.filterPlaceholder: 筛选名称、版本、路径或插件
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.redetect: 重新检测：重新探测全部工具的安装与版本，不写入任何文件。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.trustBanner: {count} 个工具来自项目内的环境（{sources}）。信任项目之前不会探测或运行它们。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.trustBannerOne: 1 个工具来自项目内的环境（{sources}）。信任项目之前不会探测或运行它。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.pluginGroupHelp: 插件为自己的语言服务器或后台进程声明的运行时。平时不用改，所以默认折叠；出了问题仍会计入“需要处理”。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.selectTool: 选择左侧的工具查看详情
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.toolFooter: 工具 ID {id} · 声明插件 {plugin}
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.restoreAutomaticTi: 去掉全局选择，重新自动查找。点“应用”后生效。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.restoreInheritedTi: 去掉本项目的选择，重新沿用全局默认。点“应用”后生效。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.problemConflict: 多个插件声明了同一工具：{plugins}。它们对这个工具的定义可能不同，Lithe 暂停解析，避免用错。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.problemNotFound: 没有找到 {tool}。安装后点工具栏的 ⟳ 重新检测，或在下方添加安装目录。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.problemVersion: 找到的安装都低于 {plugin} 要求的最低版本。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.problemProbeFailed: 版本检测失败。请检查工具的安装，然后重新检测。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.problemTrust: 这个项目用 {source}（{home}）提供 {tool}。信任项目之前不会探测或运行它。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.effectiveHelp:
工具现在实际使用的程序，由 Core 解析得出。
修改只是草稿，点窗口底部的“应用”或“好”之后才写入并重新读取。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.optionsProjectHelp:
只对当前项目生效。
“继承”沿用全局默认；项目里有插件声明的环境（Wrapper、虚拟环境等）时，信任项目后优先使用。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.optionsGlobalHelp:
所有项目共用的默认选择。
“自动”按插件声明的顺序查找：{order}，取第一个满足版本要求的安装。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.optionsGlobalHelpP:
所有项目共用的默认选择。
“自动”取第一个满足版本要求的安装。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.addHelp:
选择包含工具程序的安装根目录（例如 JDK 目录，而不是 bin 目录）。
检查只读取版本、修改草稿；点“应用”后才写入。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.reasonConflict: 多个插件声明了同一工具
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.steppingPending: 有未应用的修改，下一次调试会话生效。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.skipCodeHelp:
每条一个模式，写法由调试器决定。
调用栈中匹配的帧会淡化显示。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.skipSyntheticsHelp: 编译器自动生成的方法（如 lambda 桥接方法）在单步时直接跳过。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.skipStaticInitiali: 单步进入类时不停在静态初始化块里。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.skipConstructorsHe: 单步时不进入构造方法。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.hideFilteredFrames: 调用栈里被上面规则过滤的帧折叠成一行，展开可查看。
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.keywordsBuild: 构建 执行 部署 build
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.keywordsToolchains: 工具链 sdk jdk 版本 toolchain
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.keywordsDebuggers: 调试器 单步 debugger stepping 过滤
zh-CN.desktop.buildSettings.searchAllTools: 在工具链中查看全部 {count} 个…
zh-CN.desktop.toolchains.discoveryIncomplete: 部分已启用插件的配置无法读取，工具列表可能不完整。请查看日志，修复后重新加载。
